name: Ectopic Pregnancy
overview: Scripture acknowledges the profound sorrow and challenges that can accompany conception, as seen in God's declaration to Eve about increased sorrow in childbirth (Genesis 3:16). Yet, the Bible also affirms God's sovereign role in forming life within the womb, reminding us that He fashions each person with care (Job 31:15) and sustains them even from infancy (Psalms 22:9). Children are described as a heritage and reward from the Lord (Psalms 127:3), encouraging believers to trust in God's providence and find peace in Him amid difficult circumstances (Psalms 23:1; 112:7).
